correctness.rationale: Independent left/right rate-lambda infection frontiers give the exact Poisson-tail snapshot likelihood. A gamma-CDF integral and exponential-tilt variance establish strict age decline of every adjacent likelihood ratio; this yields strict posterior MLR ordering for any positive prior. An elementary Poisson upper-tail hazard argument establishes strict spatial log-concavity, leading to exactly one crossing for each s<k/2 and their strict ordering. The limiting ratios and equality cases were checked. Direct finite-state uniformization in verify.py independently agrees with the formula for all tested path states and ages (4137 diagnostics in total). Finite diagnostics are not used as infinite proofs.

originality.rationale: Compared implications of the exact finite-path fixed-age posterior order and MAP staircase against primary SI source-inference works. The oldest authors derive Poisson path fronts, but not an age-indexed finite-boundary posterior theorem; the most relevant general inference framework uses simulation, and the exact general recursion paper optimizes a time-independent first-reached-before-outside event. Searches of closely related aliases and other published research did not uncover a dominating equivalent statement. Priority is provisional, with explicit residual risks, not certified.
residual_risks: Historical priority cannot be globally established by indexed search and the accessed subset of source-inference literature.
A non-indexed finite-network Bayes-inference note or a theorem about gamma first-passage ratios might subsume a portion of the result.

Exponential-front independence and Poisson-tail monotonicity are classical; the proposed value and originality specifically attach to their full finite-path source-inference consequence, not to these ingredients.

value.rationale: The source of a localized infection is a natural inverse problem; knowledge of epidemic age and the fact that a surveyed infected prefix meets a physical boundary alter posterior localization. The all-prior MLR order and complete, size-independent uniform-prior MAP staircase give exact direction, number and location of posterior reversals, a genuine structural benchmark unavailable from an infected-count-only score or a numerical source ranking. It is not an isolated arbitrary parameter value or small finite enumeration, and the implications and idealized scope are explicitly bounded.
